region.name: The Harrow Reach
region.summary: A wet stretch of toll road and ferries in the Fenmarch. Guilds fight over every crossing.
customs: Ferrymen spit in the river before a crossing.
Lantern Church bells ring at dusk.
Tolls are paid in salt as often as coin.

truth: The Concord factor Hale burned the bridge to force traffic onto his ferry and hide a sealed Vael cut upriver.
stake: Your brother crossed at Harrow Ford a month ago and never reached Saltmill.
